title: SAP Learning Hub Course Mapping
description: Skill gap remediation mapping linking common technical and business skills to official SAP Learning Hub courses and learning journeys.

ABAP.description: High-level 4GL programming language created by SAP for building enterprise business applications on the SAP NetWeaver and SAP BTP platforms.

courses.title: ABAP Workbench Foundations
courses.description: Learn fundamental concepts of the ABAP development environment, syntax, modularization units, and basic database interaction in SAP systems.

courses.title: ABAP Objects
courses.description: Master object-oriented programming in ABAP, including classes, inheritance, interfaces, events, exception handling, and design patterns.

courses.title: Building Modern Applications with ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP)
courses.description: Understand Core Data Services (CDS), business service definitions, behavior definitions, and implementation of transactional cloud applications on SAP S/4HANA.

courses.title: Developing with SAP BTP ABAP Environment
courses.description: Learn cloud-ready ABAP development on SAP Business Technology Platform ('Steampunk') using clean code principles and cloud APIs.

SAP HANA.description: In-memory relational database management system designed to process high-volume transactional and analytical enterprise workloads concurrently in real time.

courses.title: SAP HANA 2.0 - 360° Introduction
courses.description: High-level overview of the SAP HANA platform architecture, in-memory computing fundamentals, calculation views, and integration with SAP systems.

courses.title: HANA 2.0 SPS06 - Advanced Data Modeling
courses.description: In-depth calculation view design, dimension and star schemas, SQLScript, table functions, decision tables, performance tuning, and spatial data.

courses.title: SAP HANA 2.0 Installation and Administration
courses.description: Operational administration of SAP HANA, including multi-tenant database management, backup and recovery, scale-out architectures, and Cockpit.

courses.title: Provisioning and Administering SAP HANA Cloud
courses.description: Managing cloud-native DB instances on SAP BTP, elastic compute scaling, data tiers (in-memory, native storage extension, data lake), and cloud integrations.

Data Analytics.description: End-to-end enterprise business intelligence, dashboarding, financial planning, predictive analytics, and enterprise data warehousing with SAP solutions.

courses.title: SAP Analytics Cloud - Overview and Core Functionality
courses.description: Gain foundational competencies in SAP Analytics Cloud: creating stories, visualizations, responsive dashboards, data connections, and smart features.

courses.title: Data Analysis and Story Design in SAP Analytics Cloud
courses.description: Advanced story design techniques, calculation models, custom formatting, mobile optimization, blending live data sources, and Smart Insights.

courses.title: SAP BW/4HANA Enterprise Data Warehousing
courses.description: Design and implement modern, agile data models using ADSOs, CompositeProviders, Open ODS Views, data transformation pipelines, and HANA synergies.

courses.title: SAP Datasphere Architecture & Data Modeling
courses.description: Unified data management in the business data fabric with SAP Datasphere, data spaces, analytical datasets, business builder, and federation.

Supply Chain Management.description: Optimization and digitization of end-to-end supply chain processes, demand planning, warehousing, inventory management, and vendor logistics in SAP.

courses.title: Business Processes in SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Execution
courses.description: Understand core logistics execution processes in S/4HANA: goods receipts, delivery management, picking and packing, posting goods issues, and billing.

courses.title: SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) - Overview & Applications
courses.description: Introduction to cloud-based supply chain planning: sales & operations planning (S&OP), demand sensing, inventory optimization, and supply & response.

courses.title: Warehouse Management in SAP S/4HANA (Extended Warehouse Management - EWM)
courses.description: Comprehensive warehouse processes in SAP EWM: storage bin structures, wave management, slotting and rearrangement, RF terminal integration, and labor management.

courses.title: Procurement and Sourcing Processes in SAP S/4HANA (Materials Management - MM)
courses.description: Procure-to-pay lifecycle: purchase requisitions, purchase orders, vendor evaluation, contract management, goods receipt, and invoice verification.

SAP Fiori.description: User experience and responsive frontend application design system and HTML5/JavaScript framework for enterprise SAP solutions.

courses.title: SAP Fiori - Foundation and Design Guidelines
courses.description: Explore the principles of SAP Fiori design, launchpad configuration, catalogs, roles, tiles, and architecture across desktop and mobile devices.

courses.title: Developing UIs with SAPUI5 and SAP Fiori
courses.description: Build custom responsive SAPUI5 web applications: MVC patterns, data binding (OData V2/V4, JSON), custom controls, fragments, and routing.

courses.title: SAP Fiori Elements - Developing Efficient Enterprise Apps
courses.description: Accelerate UI development using floorplans (List Report, Object Page, Analytical List Page, Overview Page) driven by OData annotations.

SAP BTP.description: Unified cloud platform integrating data management, analytics, artificial intelligence, application development, and integration capabilities across multi-cloud environments.

courses.title: SAP Business Technology Platform Foundation
courses.description: Foundational architectural concepts of SAP BTP: global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, Cloud Foundry, Kyma Kubernetes runtime, and security.

courses.title: Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) on SAP BTP
courses.description: Build modern enterprise cloud applications using Node.js or Java with SAP CAP, Core Data Services (CDS), SQLite/HANA persistence, and OData endpoints.

courses.title: SAP Build - Low-Code and No-Code Application Development
courses.description: Create visual apps and workflow automations using SAP Build Apps, SAP Build Process Automation, and SAP Build Work Zone.

SAP S/4HANA.description: Next-generation intelligent ERP suite running on the SAP HANA in-memory database, streamlining cross-enterprise finance, supply chain, and operations.

courses.title: SAP S/4HANA Overview - Architecture and Business Innovations
courses.description: Core architecture, simplification list, Fiori interface integration, Universal Journal, real-time analytics, and cloud deployment options.

courses.title: Business Processes in Financial Accounting in SAP S/4HANA (FI)
courses.description: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, bank accounting, financial closing, and Universal Journal entry.

courses.title: Business Processes in Management Accounting in SAP S/4HANA (CO)
courses.description: Controlling (CO) fundamentals: cost center accounting, internal orders, product costing, profitability analysis (CO-PA), and cost object controlling.

SAP Integration Suite.description: Enterprise integration platform-as-a-service (iPaaS) connecting cloud and on-premise SAP and third-party systems seamlessly.

courses.title: SAP Integration Suite - Overview and Core Capabilities
courses.description: Foundational iPaaS concepts: Cloud Integration flows (iFlows), API Management, Open Connectors, Integration Advisor, and Event Mesh.

courses.title: Developing Integration Flows with SAP Cloud Integration
courses.description: Design secure iFlows, message mappings (XSLT, Groovy Script), content enrichers, splitters/aggregators, adapters (REST, SOAP, SFTP, OData, Kafka), and exception handling.

Machine Learning & AI in SAP.description: Enterprise machine learning pipelines, Large Language Model deployments, GenAI integration, and automated business processes utilizing SAP AI Core.

courses.title: Introduction to Generative AI with SAP
courses.description: Understand SAP's AI ethics principles, Joule enterprise copilot, prompt engineering, generative AI hub on SAP BTP, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

courses.title: Building Intelligent Applications with SAP AI Core and AI Launchpad
courses.description: Containerized machine learning model execution (Docker/Kubernetes), model serving pipelines, GitOps workflows with Argo, dataset versioning, and serving LLM endpoints.

Cloud & DevOps.description: Container orchestration, automated deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, and cloud engineering best practices for enterprise solutions.

courses.title: Cloud-Native Development & Containerization on SAP BTP
courses.description: Containerizing microservices with Docker, deploying to SAP BTP Kyma runtime (Kubernetes), configuring Istio service mesh, ingress, and continuous delivery.

courses.title: Continuous Integration and Delivery with SAP Cloud SDK
courses.description: Automated pipelines using SAP BTP CI/CD service, Piper library, quality gates, automated testing, and multi-cloud deployment automation.
